title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:22:0:00025:part:1/1

Article 22 (Claim for Payment of Expired or Unclear Receipts)
① Any person who wishes to receive payment based on a receipt that is unclear or expired according to Article 8(1), (3), and (4) of the Act, or a receipt that does not comply with the requirements of Article 8(1), (3), and (4) of the Act, must submit the relevant receipt to the post office along with a claim for payment.
② Any person who has lost a receipt according to Article 8(2), (3), and (4) of the Act, and wishes to receive payment, must submit a non-receipt application to the post office. In this case, if a person has lost a receipt within its validity period, they must make a claim for payment suspension according to Article 27, and then submit the non-receipt application after the period of 3 days from the date of the claim. <Amended July 31, 1998, April 30, 2007>
③ After receiving a claim according to Article 1 and 2, the post office must verify whether the claimant has a legitimate right to receive payment and then proceed with the payment.
④ Deleted <July 31, 1998>
